  .cap { margin: 0.875rem 0 0; }
  .drawn b, .cap b, .sub b { color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .sub { margin: 1.5rem 0 0.5rem; max-width: 48rem; font-size: var(--text-meta); color: var(--color-muted); }
  .sub:first-of-type { margin-top: 0; }
  .cref {
    display: inline-block; font-size: var(--text-meta); font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-chip); padding: 0 0.375rem; margin: 0 0.125rem;
    background: var(--color-card);
  }
  .canvas {
    position: relative; background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-modal); overflow: hidden;
  }
  .canvas.tall { min-height: 28rem; }
  .addr {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); background: var(--color-surface-medium);
    font-size: var(--text-meta); color: var(--color-muted);
  }
  .addr b { color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .elide {
    margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px dashed var(--color-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-size: var(--text-meta); font-style: italic;
    color: var(--color-muted); text-align: center;
  }
  .variant-label {
    position: absolute; top: 0.75rem; right: 1rem; z-index: 1; font-size: var(--text-meta);
    font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted);
  }

  /* ---- The frame (frontend/src/components/shell/PageFrame.tsx) ---- */
  .fr { padding: 0 1.5rem 3rem; }
  .fr-full { padding-bottom: 6rem; }
  .fr-crop { padding-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  .fr.has-toast { padding-bottom: 6rem; }
  .fr-col { max-width: var(--container-reading); margin: 0 auto; }
  .fr-head {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem 1rem; padding-top: 1.75rem;
  }
  .fr-strip { padding-bottom: 1.75rem; }
  .fr-left { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem 2rem; }
  .board .lockup { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration: none; }
  .board .lockup:hover { color: var(--color-ink); }
  .lockup-mark {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    width: 1.625rem; height: 1.625rem; border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
    background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-inverse);
    font-size: var(--text-meta); font-weight: 600;
  }
  .lockup-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .fr-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; }
  .board .fr-nav a { color: var(--color-muted); text-decoration: none; }
  .board .fr-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-ink); }
  .board .fr-nav a[aria-current="page"] {
    color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.375rem;
  }
  .fr-meta { font-size: var(--text-meta); color: var(--color-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .fr-title {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.625rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); padding: 3.5rem 0 2.5rem;
  }
  .t-h1 {
    margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-weight: 400;
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 4.25rem); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  .t-lede { margin: 0; max-width: 44ch; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--color-muted); text-wrap: pretty; }
  .fr-foot { padding-top: 4rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; color: var(--color-faint); }

  /* ---- The add field (TodoTaskComposer) ---- */
  .composer-sec { padding: 1.75rem 0 1.25rem; }
  .composer {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0.75rem 1.125rem;
  }
  .composer-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .composer-field { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; }
  .composer-input {
    width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0;
    font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-ink);
  }
  .composer-input:disabled, .editor-input:disabled { color: var(--color-muted); cursor: progress; }
  .is-focused { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .btn-add {
    flex: none; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--color-accent);
    color: var(--color-inverse); padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500;
  }
  .btn-add:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); }
  .btn-add:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .field-error { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-danger); }

  /* ---- The list and a task's row (TodoTaskRow, Checkbox) ---- */
  .tasks {
    list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--color-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-card); overflow: hidden;
  }
  .task { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; }
  .task + .task { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); }
  .task.rise { animation: rise 0.28s ease both; }
  .task-main {
    position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem;
    flex: 1; min-width: 0; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .task-main-box { flex: none; }
  .task-input {
    position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.125rem; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem;
    margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .task-input:disabled { cursor: progress; }
  .box {
    flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; margin-top: 0.125rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--color-faint); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--color-card);
  }
  .box svg {
    width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; fill: none; stroke: var(--color-inverse);
    stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; opacity: 0;
  }
  .task-input:checked + .box { background: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); }
  .task-input:checked + .box svg { opacity: 1; }
  .task-input:focus-visible + .box { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .task-input:disabled + .box { opacity: 0.5; }
  .task-text { min-width: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .task-input:checked ~ .task-text { text-decoration-line: line-through; color: var(--color-muted); }
  .marker { flex: none; font-size: var(--text-meta); line-height: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-faint); }
  .task-actions { flex: none; display: flex; gap: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; }
  .act {
    border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-size: var(--text-meta);
    line-height: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-faint);
  }
  .act-edit:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--color-accent); }
  .act-del:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--color-danger); }
  .act:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }
  .task-elide {
    justify-content: center; background: var(--color-surface); font-size: var(--text-meta);
    font-style: italic; color: var(--color-muted);
  }

  /* ---- Editing in place ---- */
  .editor { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .editor-field { display: flex; }
  .editor-input {
    width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-control-tight);
    background: var(--color-card); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem;
    color: var(--color-ink);
  }
  .editor-input:disabled { background: var(--color-surface); }
  .editor-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .btn-save {
    border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control-tight); background: var(--color-accent);
    color: var(--color-inverse); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: var(--text-meta); font-weight: 500;
  }
  .btn-save:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.15); }
  .btn-save:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .btn-cancel {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-control-tight);
    background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: var(--text-meta);
  }
  .btn-cancel:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-surface-medium); }
  .btn-cancel:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

  /* ---- Empty, loading, failed ---- */
  .empty {
    border: 1px dashed var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    padding: 3.5rem 1.25rem; text-align: center; font-size: var(--text-body); color: var(--color-muted);
  }
  .task-skel { align-items: center; }
  .skel { display: block; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--color-surface-medium); }
  .skel-box { flex: none; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; }
  .skel-bar { height: 0.625rem; }
  .w-2-5 { width: 40%; } .w-1-2 { width: 50%; } .w-3-5 { width: 60%; } .w-4-5 { width: 80%; }
  .read-failed { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-size: var(--text-meta); color: var(--color-muted); }
  .err {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    background: var(--color-card); padding: 2rem 1.5rem; text-align: center;
  }
  .err-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; }
  .err-detail { margin: 0.5rem auto 0; max-width: 42rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--color-muted); }
  .err-actions { margin-top: 0.875rem; display: flex; justify-content: center; }

  /* ---- Buttons (frontend/src/components/ui/Button.tsx) ---- */
  .btn-outlined, .btn-quiet, .btn-primary, .btn-link-primary {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.125rem;
    padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-outlined { border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-ink); }
  .btn-outlined:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent); }
  .btn-quiet { border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); }
  .btn-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-surface-medium); color: var(--color-ink); }
  .btn-quiet:disabled { color: var(--color-disabled); cursor: default; }
  .btn-primary { border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-inverse); }
  .btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); }
  .btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }
  .board .btn-link-primary {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-accent);
    color: var(--color-inverse); text-decoration: none;
  }
  .nf-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding-top: 2.5rem; }

  /* ---- Toasts (frontend/src/components/ui/Toast.tsx) ---- */
  .toasts {
    position: absolute; right: 1.25rem; bottom: 1.25rem; z-index: 2;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: calc(100% - 2.5rem);
  }
  .toast {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.625rem; max-width: 28rem;
    border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-inverse);
    padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.625; font-weight: 700;
    box-shadow:
      0 1.25rem 1.5625rem -0.3125rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 10%, transparent),
      0 0.5rem 0.625rem -0.375rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 10%, transparent);
  }
  .glyph { flex: none; font-weight: 700; }
  .glyph-ok { color: var(--color-inverse); }
  .glyph-err { color: var(--color-danger); }
  .toast-msg { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .toast-x {
    flex: none; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px;
    font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700;
    color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-inverse) 60%, transparent);
  }
  .toast-x:hover { color: var(--color-inverse); }

  /* ---- The delete question (DeleteTodoTaskDialog over Modal.tsx) ---- */
  .backdrop {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 3; display: flex; align-items: center;
    justify-content: center; padding: 1.5rem;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 45%, transparent);
  }
  .dialog {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; max-width: 36rem; overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-modal);
    background: var(--color-card);
    box-shadow: 0 1.5625rem 3.125rem -0.75rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .dialog-head { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; }
  .dialog-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; }
  .dialog-body { padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; }
  .quote {
    margin: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-surface);
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .dialog-foot {
    display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.625rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  }
  .dialog-note { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
  .dialog-btns { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }

  /* ---- The guestbook's composer, drawn only in P17 ---- */
  .gb-composer-sec { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); padding: 1.75rem 0 2rem; }
  .gb-card {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.875rem; background: var(--color-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-card); padding: 1.125rem;
  }
  .gb-name {
    border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-size: var(--text-body);
    font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .gb-rule { height: 1px; background: var(--color-hairline); }
  .gb-msg {
    border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans);
    font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; resize: none;
  }
  .gb-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; }

content.text: Now the focus rule, in its one home under § Keyboard and accessibility.

input.old_string:
- **After a successful add the focus stays in the add field**, so the next task can be typed at
  once. **The question takes the focus on "Cancel"**, keeps Tab inside itself, and on closing
  hands the focus back to the "Delete" that opened it — or, when that row is gone, to the list,
  never to the page's start. Where the focus goes in the other moments a control it was on is
  locked or removed is not decided: § States with no defined behaviour, question 2.
input.new_string:
- **The focus goes back where the person was.** While a write travels its control is locked, and
  a locked control lets go of the focus; when the answer comes, the focus is put back, never left
  at the page's start:
  - **after a tick settles, either way**, on that row's box;
  - **after any add, whether it went through or not**, in the add field — so after a successful
    add the next task can be typed at once, and after a failed one the text that stayed can be
    sent again;
  - **after a correction that did not go through** — refused by the service, the task no longer
    existing, nothing answered, or an error of no sentence of its own — in the edit field, which
    stays open with what was typed;
  - **when the editor closes on "Save" or "Cancel"**, on that row's "Edit".

  Each applies when the focus was on the control that was locked or closed — the add field or
  "Add task"; the box; the edit field, "Save" or "Cancel" — and a person who has put the focus
  somewhere else meanwhile keeps it where they put it.
- **The question takes the focus on "Cancel"**, keeps Tab inside itself, and on closing hands the
  focus back to the "Delete" that opened it — or, when that row is gone, to the list, never to
  the page's start.

content.text: Now the section that held the two open questions.

input.old_string:
Two questions the mock-up and the requirements leave open. Neither is filled in here; each waits
for a person's answer.

1. **The words of a failed change when the service answered with an error of no sentence of its
   own** — a server error, for instance, rather than a coded refusal or no answer at all. The
   mock-up words the two cases it drew: nothing answered ("…the service could not be reached.")

   sentence of its own; (C) "The task was not added." / "The change was not made." followed by the

   removed.** Options: (A) back where the person was — on the box after a tick settles, in the add
   field after an add settles either way, in the edit field after a correction fails, and on the
   row's "Edit" when the editor closes on "Save" or "Cancel" — recommended; (B) not specified,
   left to the browser as the guestbook does today; (C) as (A), except that the row's box takes the
   focus when the editor closes.

## The two questions, answered

The first attempt returned these two as `NEEDS_DECISION`; the person who asked for the change
answered both on 2026-09-24, and each answer is written into `spec/design/ui/todo-list.md` as
given, with nothing beyond it. No state of the screen is left without defined behaviour.

| Question | Answer | Landed in |
|---|---|---|
| `Q-15` — the words when a write fails and the service answered with an error of no sentence of its own (a server error, rather than a coded refusal or no answer) | A — `The task was not added: the service answered with an error.` for an add; `The change was not made: the service answered with an error.` for a tick, a correction and a deletion | § Copy (two rows, and the paragraph saying which sentence answers which case); § Interactions (the new failure branch on adding, ticking, correcting and deleting) |
| `Q-16` — where the focus goes when a control it was on is locked for a write and then unlocked, or removed | A — back where the person was: on the row's box after a tick settles, in the add field after any add, in the edit field after a correction that did not go through, and on the row's "Edit" when the editor closes on "Save" or "Cancel" | § Keyboard and accessibility (the bullet "The focus goes back where the person was", which replaces the sentence pointing at the open question) |

Rejected with those answers, as the options put them: for `Q-15`, the "could not be reached"
sentence for every failure with no sentence of its own (untrue when the service did answer), and
the bare sentence followed by the error's title as the browser names it; for `Q-16`, leaving the
focus to the browser as the guestbook does today (it can drop the focus to the page's start), and
giving the row's box the focus when the editor closes.

input.new_string:
- **A tick travelling locks only its own box.** C-15 names the box alone; P10 draws "Edit"
  locked on the ticking row because a correction was travelling in the same frame, which locks
  "Edit" on every row.
- **"An error of no sentence of its own" is an answer that carries no refusal sentence.** `Q-15`
  was asked with "for example an internal server error"; the document draws the line where the
  screen already reads the words — § Data: a refusal's `detail.message` is the words — so any
  answer that came and carries no such sentence gets "…the service answered with an error.",
  and one that carries it shows it (C-18). The rejected reading keys the words to a status code
  (every `5xx`), which leaves a status with no sentence and no `5xx` — a proxy's `502` is a `5xx`,
  but a gateway's bare `413` is not — with no words at all.
- **The focus goes back only when it was on the control that was locked or closed.** `Q-16` was
  asked as "while a change is being saved, its control is locked; where does the keyboard focus
  go when that control is unlocked again, or removed?", which presumes the focus was on it; the
  document says so, and says that a person who put the focus somewhere else while the write
  travelled keeps it there. The rejected reading moves the focus back on every answer, which
  pulls a keyboard user off the row they tabbed to while a slow tick was still travelling —
  "back where the person was" read against where the person now is. The add counts "Add task"
  as its control as well as the field (both are locked while an add travels), so a pointer
  press on "Add task" also brings the focus back to the field, as the answer's "after any add"
  says.

content.content:
- **"Edit"** → the row's editor opens with this task's stored text and the focus in the field;
  an editor open on another row closes.
- **"Edit" while a correction travels** → nothing: it is locked on every row until the answer.
- **Leaving the edit field, or Enter, with a refused text** → the rule's sentence under the field;
  nothing is sent.
- **"Save", or Enter in the edit field, with an accepted text** → the text is sent; meanwhile the
  `saving` state. On success the editor closes, the new text stands in the task's place, its done
  state as it was, and a notice says "Task updated.". If the task no longer exists: the
  `todo_task_not_found` sentence in a notice; the editor stays open with what was typed and no
  task with the new text appears. If nothing answered: "The change was not made: the service
  could not be reached.", and the editor stays open with what was typed. If the service answered
  with an error of no sentence of its own: "The change was not made: the service answered with an
  error.", and the editor stays open with what was typed. In all three, the stored text is
  unchanged and comes back on "Cancel". If the service refused the text: its sentence under the
  edit field.
----

- **The Tab order** is the frame's lockup and navigation, the add field, "Add task" when it is
  open, then row by row from the top: the box, "Edit", "Delete"; in a row being edited, the box,
  the edit field, "Save", "Cancel", "Delete". A locked control is skipped.
- **Enter in the add field** adds an accepted text or shows the rule's sentence. **Space on a
  box** ticks it or unticks it. **Enter in the edit field** saves an accepted text or shows the
  sentence. **Escape** does nothing in the editor and closes the question, except while a
  deletion travels.
- **The focus goes back where the person was.** While a write travels its control is locked, and
  a locked control lets go of the focus; when the answer comes, the focus is put back, never left
  at the page's start:
  - **after a tick settles, either way**, on that row's box;
  - **after any add, whether it went through or not**, in the add field — so after a successful
    add the next task can be typed at once, and after a failed one the text that stayed can be
    sent again;
  - **after a correction that did not go through** — refused by the service, the task no longer
    existing, nothing answered, or an error of no sentence of its own — in the edit field, which
    stays open with what was typed;
  - **when the editor closes on "Save" or "Cancel"**, on that row's "Edit".

  Each applies when the focus was on the control that was locked or closed — the add field or
  "Add task"; the box; the edit field, "Save" or "Cancel" — and a person who has put the focus
  somewhere else meanwhile keeps it where they put it.
- **The question takes the focus on "Cancel"**, keeps Tab inside itself, and on closing hands the
  focus back to the "Delete" that opened it — or, when that row is gone, to the list, never to
  the page's start.
- **The focus ring is the screen's**, in the accent colour, on everything that can take the focus:
  the add field, each box (drawn around the box), "Edit", "Delete", the edit field, "Save",

content.text:
I've applied both answers to the to-do screen specification, and `sdd-skill design-ui verify` passes.

- **Failure wording (Q-15):** when the service answers with an error that has no sentence of its own, the screen shows "The task was not added: the service answered with an error." after an add. After a tick, a correction or a delete it shows "The change was not made: the service answered with an error." These are now in the copy table and in each of the four write interactions.
- **Focus (Q-16):** focus returns to the checkbox after a tick settles, and to the add field after any add. After a failed correction it goes to the edit field, and to the row's Edit button when the editor closes on Save or Cancel. This rule is in the keyboard and accessibility section.
- **Open questions:** the section that held the two questions now says none remain.

I added two interpretations to make the answers buildable. Both are recorded, with the rejected alternative, in the change's design notes (`design/delta/ui.md`):
- **Which errors get the new words:** any answer that carries no refusal message, rather than any 5xx status. A status-code rule would leave some errors with no words at all.
- **When focus moves back:** only when it was on the control that got locked or closed. Someone who tabbed elsewhere while a slow save was running keeps the focus where they put it. Clicking "Add task" also counts as being on the add controls, so focus still returns to the field after any add.

One problem from the previous attempt is still open, and it's outside what this step may edit. `spec/contexts/todo_list.md` still says `screens: []`, so `test_context_declarations` will stay red until that file lists `spec/design/ui/todo-list.md`.
